description: This PHP source file defines the KeycloakService class, which provides methods for interacting with Keycloak identity management, including user creation, credential retrieval, MFA enabling, password reset, and user deletion.

classes.name: KeycloakService
classes.description: A service class for managing Keycloak user operations such as creation, credential retrieval, MFA, password reset, and deletion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with a logger and application configuration, setting up the Keycloak settings.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with the base URI and timeout.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Fetches and returns the public key from the Keycloak realm.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Obtains an access token from Keycloak using client credentials.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak with specified user data and password, returning the new user's UUID.

methods.name: getUserCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a specified user.

methods.name: enableMfa
methods.description: Enables MFA for a user by requiring TOTP configuration.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Resets a user's password by requiring an update action.

methods.name: requireAction
methods.description: Internal method to set required actions for a user, such as MFA or password update.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user information by email (void return).
